about_the_game:
Catch the Light is a gentle home training app for vision and reading. Short, focused sessions help develop perception, attention, and confidence while reading. Designed for adults who want to strengthen visual habits and make practice part of their daily routine.

What you do in 3–15 minutes a day

  • Mini-game for visual scanning and perception

  • Reading exercises with different mechanics

  • Reflection journal to note how each session went

  • Home visual checks for self-monitoring (non-diagnostic)

  • Customizable settings: font size, speed, themes, and session duration

Progress you can see

Track your progress and reading results over time to notice changes and stay motivated.

Who it's for

For adults who want a simple, supportive home routine for more comfortable reading, confidence, and daily visual scanning.

Important

Catch the Light is not a medical application and is not intended to diagnose, treat, or prevent any disease. All exercises and checks are intended for personal use and self-monitoring only.

Cloud and privacy

Catch the Light may use generative technologies to create new reading content. We do not collect personal data, share it with third parties, or sell it. Learn more in our Privacy Policy.
